<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Guard''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍衛兵</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">移動不可。＊攻撃中は戦闘力＝０、防御中は戦闘力＝４として扱う。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-26o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ゲイラン・トーグは、ヤヴィンの戦いの勝利を祝す記念式典の間、名誉ある衛兵の任務に選ばれた。任務に忠実で、称えられることもない反乱同盟軍の英雄たちの典型と言えよう。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Guard.

'''Card text:''' Cannot move. * Power = 0 while attacking. Power = 4 while defending.

'''Lore:''' Gailan Torg was chosen for honorary guard duty at the ceremony celebrating victory at Yavin. Faithful to the assignment, and typical of the unsung heroes of the Rebel Alliance.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Guard]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
